progression: Add 1 rep per set, add one set, reduce assistance, or add 2.5-5% load only after two clean sessions.
regression: Reduce range, slow down, use support, remove load, or switch to a simpler related pattern.

nutrition_pairing: protein + carbohydrate meal within normal daily needs; hydrate
recovery_notes: Pair with mobility for the primary muscles and avoid repeating high intensity on the same muscle group on consecutive days.
